# hydra_trusted_jwt_grant_issuers (Data Source)

Lists trusted JWT Bearer grant issuers (optionally filtered by `issuer`). Useful to find trust IDs for `import` blocks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hydra_trusted_jwt_grant_issuers" "ci" {
  issuer = "https://ci.example.com"
}

output "trust_ids_by_kid" {
  value = { for t in data.hydra_trusted_jwt_grant_issuers.ci.issuers : t.kid => t.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `issuer` (String) Only return trusts for this issuer.

### Read-Only

- `issuers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issuers))
